explanation.narrative:
This workspace has 9 ChangedWithoutSchema contract findings for the openshell-gateway RPC interface. Five of the findings (F1, F2, F5, F8, and F9) are classified as NeedsInvestigation with unresolved_candidates, meaning the engine could not determine impact for some consumers. Sixteen other affected consumer entries are also NeedsInvestigation: unresolved_candidates, reflecting the same engine limitation. The remaining four findings (F3, F4, F6, F7) are classified as NeedsInvestigation with no_schema, where the engine detected a schema change but could not map it to any consumer impact. Two consumer services—OpenShell and NemoClaw—appear as both self-consumers and external consumers; NeMo-Fabric appears as an external consumer for F1, F2, F5, F8, and F9 but its impact is unresolved. No impact paths could be fully resolved due to the INCOMPLETE coverage (trace_impact was skipped for 1 of 9 changed contracts).
